standard_prerequisites.name: Finite modules over a Noetherian ring are pseudo-coherent, and pseudo-coherent modules are finite
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-resolution-by-finite-free} and Lemma \ref{lemma-n-pseudo-module}, cited at proof lines 16531-16535

core_obligations: Prove the module statement by combining the two implications between finiteness and pseudo-coherence (proof lines 16531-16535).
Read finiteness of the cohomology in degrees at least m from the finite free approximation (proof lines 16536-16542).
Derive the converse from the cohomology criterion and conclude the two complex statements (proof lines 16543-16546).
proof_roadmap: Converse via the cohomology criterion (proof lines 16543-16546).
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises m-pseudo-coherence and pseudo-coherence of a complex over a Noetherian ring by boundedness above together with finiteness of the cohomology modules in the relevant degrees, and deduces that a module is pseudo-coherent exactly when it is finite. The proof first combines the standard fact that finite modules are pseudo-coherent with the statement that pseudo-coherent modules are finite to settle the module case, then reads off finiteness of the cohomology from the bounded complex of finite free modules provided by m-pseudo-coherence, and obtains the converse from the cohomology-by-cohomology criterion.
